explanation: The export claims model-sol through actual_model; the null plural alias does not cancel that claim. The known export hash identifies bytes but does not independently verify runtime identity, and the raw host log is unavailable.

Completed is a process claim, the stated checkout used a mock provider, and the real-TEST native pilot had N3 disabled. These facts do not establish an end-to-end real-provider agent-to-N3 purchase chain.
The parent total explicitly includes the child, so adding 40 would double-count the same covered usage. The unique inclusive total represented by the pair is 100 tokens.

Token share does not determine billed-cost share, tariffs are absent, cached input has distinct billing semantics, and coordinator work includes product implementation. The unnecessary-orchestration fraction is unsupported.

An approval request precedes the gap, but the record explicitly leaves approval wait versus session interruption unresolved. It does not conclusively attribute the whole eight hours to approval waiting.

The three runs have materially different scopes from each other and from a complete new commercial product, and wait intervals are unavailable. They cannot support a calibrated P80 for the requested task.
